verdict.rationale: The evidence shows built-in automatic AI labels and junk filtering, an API, and an MCP server for on-demand actions. None of these documents user-defined rules that trigger actions automatically when mail events occur. The AI labels and junk filter are adjacent automatic features, and the API and MCP server are developer building blocks or on-request actions, not a rules engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
